verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.sentry.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Sentry Documentation index. Sentry also ships agent-oriented tooling: `npx @sentry/ai install` teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok how to set up Sentry, and the official MCP server lets assistants read documentation. Missing for 10: evidence on the depth or coverage of the llms.txt content (only its header was captured), and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
